subject: Zero-Shot Learning
source_sentence: The recent work on so-called zero-shot learning to address the annotation bottleneck in image labeling looks at image- and text-based vectors from a different perspective.
title: Combining Language and Vision with a Multimodal Skip-gram Model

subject: Models
source_sentence: The parameters of all models are estimated by back-propagation of error via stochastic gradient descent.
title: Combining Language and Vision with a Multimodal Skip-gram Model

subject: Text
source_sentence: Our text corpus is a Wikipedia 2009 dump comprising approximately 800M tokens.
title: Combining Language and Vision with a Multimodal Skip-gram Model

subject: Models
source_sentence: To train the multi-modal models, we add visual information for 5,100 words that have an entry in ImageNet , occur at least 500 times in the corpus and have concreteness score ≥0.5 according to Turney et al.
title: Combining Language and Vision with a Multimodal Skip-gram Model

subject: Convolutional Neural Network
source_sentence: To construct the visual representation of a word, we sample 100 pictures from its ImageNet entry, and extract a 4096-dimensional vector from each picture using the Caffe toolkit , together with the pre-trained convolutional neural network of Krizhevsky et al.
title: Combining Language and Vision with a Multimodal Skip-gram Model
